items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: That was Bill Morrell, that was their daddy, yeah, that was my uncle.

ctx.x: Yeah, all of them, yeah. Paul, Aidan Lawrence. Then they had two other older brothers too, they was banjo, like, I know you heard of Simon, John Morrell, well that was the older brother. It was four brothers, two played bass, two played banjo.
Uh huh, Billy, that was, who was that your uncle?
That was Bill Morrell, that was their daddy, yeah, that was my uncle.
